question: Definite shape, distinct boundaries are the characteristics of which state of matter?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Solid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Matters are generally categorized into 3 states:

 
 
• Solid: Particles are held very close to each other and can't move. 
 
• Liquid: Particles are close to each other but they can move around. 
 
• Gas: Particles are far from each other as compared to those present in solid or liquid states and their movement is easy and fast. 
 
 
 
• Plasma is one of the fourth fundamental states of matter.
 
• As it has properties unlike those of the other states. ​
 
• Plasma is created by adding energy to a gas so that some of its electrons leave their atoms.
 
• This is called ionization.
 
• Bose-Einstein Condensate: A group of atoms cooled to absolute zero temperature(-273.15 K). It is the fifth state of matter.
